text.tspan: TEST SETUP: GP2/GP3 are shorted inside this KB2040 and left unconnected; brakes on GP29 (L) and GP20 (R), battery bar 4 off.
TEST SETUP: tail (runner) on GP12, the Stemma QT SDA pin, because GP29 is taken; it moves to GP29 with the new board.
Spare: Stemma QT SCL (GP13); 3V3 out unused. Onboard NeoPixel on GP17 is unused.
